about_the_game:
Should I play?

Imagine this: you're in VR, bow in hand, holding the line while waves of twisted monsters charge through a fantasy forest. Magic flying around, corrupted trolls roaring, and you’re just nailing headshots like a true elven badass.

Now picture doing that in co-op mode, watching each other's backs, yelling in panic, and celebrating when you survive the next wave. Only smart teamwork and quick strategic shots in VR can lead you to victory.

That’s Archer – Virtual Realms.
Stylized, intense, and surprisingly beautiful. It’s not just another shooter. It’s an atmospheric experience with unique mechanics and an immersive story set. It feels amazing!

Features

  • Unlock powerful new abilities only through experimentation.

  • Each new skill opens entirely new ways to fight, survive, and adapt to the enemy.

  • Designed to minimize motion sickness.

  • Take short breaks in immersive, atmospheric scenes to physically recover between battles.

  • Brutal difficulty mode that demands skill, focus, and adaptability.

  • Take on massive, corrupted creatures that push your skill and strategy to the limit.

  • Detailed leaderboards highlight the top performers.

  • Fight solo or with others against overwhelming odds.

content_descriptors.notes:
Archer – Virtual Realms features stylized fantasy battles where players fight off waves of corrupted creatures using archery and elemental magic. Some enemies have dark or eerie designs, including skeletal armour and mutated features, but there is no blood, gore, or realistic violence.

The game contains no sexual content, explicit language, or depictions of substance use or abuse. All content is presented within a fantasy context and is not intended to resemble real-world violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: VR SDKs Supported: SteamVR, OpenXR Headsets: Valve Index, HTC Vive, Meta Quest 2 / 3 (via Link or Air Link), Oculus Rift / Rift S, Windows Mixed Reality Input: Requires two motion controllers Play Area: Seated, Standing, or Room-Scale
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: VR SDKs Supported: SteamVR, OpenXR Headsets: Valve Index, HTC Vive, Meta Quest 2 / 3 (via Link or Air Link), Oculus Rift / Rift S, Windows Mixed Reality Input: Requires two motion controllers Play Area: Seated, Standing, or Room-Scale

short_description: Grab your bow and fight the enemy army. Complete a story campaign full of adventures and unique mechanics. Join the competitive mode to get on the leaderboards alone or with friends online. And remember, only the right strategy and curiosity will lead to victory.
